assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles derived from the announcement text and approximate areas; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and figures derived from these polygons are design-level estimates; the full chain must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are schematic massing units (411 units, ~3.51 million sqm) used only to test the order of magnitude of spatial ideas.
assumptions.impact: Not an existing-building inventory, not a construction commitment, and not a statutory floor-area conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are a conceptual network (spine, cross links, transit connections) for spatial organization testing.
assumptions.impact: Not road redlines; alignment must be verified against official road and rail redlines.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, operators, event systems, and operation mechanisms are conceptual directions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: Not confirmed government arrangements, not approved operations, and not investment commitments.

assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory conditions (FAR, height, density, setbacks), road redlines, existing building survey, ownership, municipal utilities, and heritage control lines are pending.
assumptions.impact: These items are recorded as status=unknown in metrics.json and treated as preconditions for formal deepening.

assumptions.statement: Land-use polygons partition the full submitted boundary without gaps or overlaps (gap < 30 sqm on a 11.41 sqkm site, within coordinate-rounding tolerance).
assumptions.impact: Land-use totals reconcile with the site boundary area.
